claim: On neutral_hostile_v1/09_ml_artifacts, promoted G04 policy verification time is almost entirely graph streaming rather than session-open/preflight, and the reader decodes each physical record exactly once rather than thrashing its bounded cache.

decision.hypothesis_metadata: Session open, authenticated metadata and preflight validation are a material owner of G04 verify wall time.
decision.hypothesis_cache: Bounded record-cache churn causes repeated physical record decoding and materially owns the G04 verify regression.
decision.reason: Session open is only 0.27% of policy-verify median wall time. Full verification performs exactly 19 physical record reads for 19 unique records, multiplicity 1.00x. 99.73% of wall time remains after session open and is not explained by repeated physical-record reads.
retire: Do not enlarge the record cache merely to chase this ML verification regression; no physical-record reread exists on the measured archive.
Do not optimize metadata/session opening as the primary runtime lane; addressable median headroom is below one millisecond here.
decision.next_question: Attribute the one-pass stream work among physical codec decode/inverse transforms, node reconstruction (delta/mosaic/direct), and integrity/tree hashing. Optimize only the measured owner while preserving exact integrity and locality semantics.

scope: One-workload research attribution only. It does not establish cache behavior for every G04 archive and grants no release credit.
